# Scott Arthur Yerkey Interiors

Interior architecture and design studio based in Chicago, Illinois. Scott Arthur Yerkey creates composed, enduring luxury residential interiors. Commissions accepted by introduction.

## Studio

- Principal: Scott Arthur Yerkey
- Location: 4809 N Ravenswood Ave, Suite 117, Chicago, IL 60640
- Phone: +1 (312) 771-3538
- Email: chris@scottarthuryerkey.com
- Markets: Chicago — New York — London — Los Angeles

## Pages

- [Home](https://scottarthuryerkey.com/): Full portfolio overview including hero, philosophy, selected residences, process, recognition, and inquiry form.
- [The Four Seasons Residences](https://scottarthuryerkey.com/projects/the-four-seasons-residences): Full-floor luxury residence in one of Chicago's most celebrated buildings. Venetian plaster, aged brass, and stone from a single quarry. Chicago, Illinois — 2024.
- [Sunset Lane](https://scottarthuryerkey.com/projects/sunset-lane): Gracious North Shore estate in Lake Forest. Natural materials — linen, limestone, hand-hewn oak — composed for Midwestern light. Lake Forest, Illinois — 2024.
- [Lakeside](https://scottarthuryerkey.com/projects/lakeside): Summer residence on Lake Michigan's eastern shore. Bleached oak, raw concrete, palette drawn from dune grass, water, and sky. Lake Michigan, Michigan — 2023.
- [Highland Park](https://scottarthuryerkey.com/projects/highland-park): Complete interior commission in Highland Park's historic district. Every room considered as part of a coherent whole. Highland Park, Illinois — 2023.
- [Rancho Mirage](https://scottarthuryerkey.com/projects/rancho-mirage): Desert estate at the Villaggio Place development. Palette drawn from the Sonoran landscape — terracotta, sage, and raw steel. Rancho Mirage, California — 2022.
- [Halco Dunes](https://scottarthuryerkey.com/projects/halco-dunes): Dunes retreat on the southern shore of Lake Michigan. Sand, cedar, and weathered steel. Michigan City, Indiana — 2022.
- [W. Winona](https://scottarthuryerkey.com/projects/w-winona): Chicago greystone reimagined. No element added that the building did not already suggest. Chicago, Illinois — 2022.
